explication: Paaster is a privacy-focused pastebin: users create encrypted pastes in the browser, retrieve them by link, and can manage paste history through an account. The server stores paste metadata and encrypted content, while browser-held secrets and URI fragments keep decryption client-side. Separate capabilities include passphrase protection, expiration/deletion, themes, QR sharing, and short-lived device transfer. The graph includes these documented product branches; unsampled implementation details are represented only at paths present in the tree, and relationships without direct evidence are omitted.
